translations.web: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!
translations.bsb: They prepare a table, they lay out a carpet, they eat, they drink! Rise up, O princes, oil the shields!
translations.kjv: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.
translations.asv: They prepare the table, they set the watch, they eat, they drink: rise up, ye princes, anoint the shield.
